newsitem.title: USA: CCC buys 23,194 T U.S. wheat for Honduras. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CCC buys 23,194 T U.S. wheat for Honduras. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corporation on September 12 bought 23,194 tonnes U.S. wheat for donation to Honduras.
(Corrects to delete reference in headline and first paragraph to the wheat being bought under PL 480, Title I export distribution program)

It bought 4,750 tonnes of Northern Spring/Dark Northern Spring wheat from Peavey Co at $181.84 a tonne and 2,844 tonnes of soft red winter wheat from Peavey at $176.69 slated for November 1-25 delivery.
The deal also includes 9,600 tonnes of NS/DNS wheat from Peavey at $181.84 a tonne and 6,000 tonnes SRW wheat from ADM at $174.87, set for December 10-30 delivery.
The CCC is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
